title: TDM-R1: Reinforcing Few-Step Diffusion Models with Non-Differentiable Reward

summary.en: Adapts few-step image generators to non-differentiable rewards by separating surrogate reward learning from generator optimization. Reward signals along deterministic TDM trajectories support post-training for text rendering, visual quality, and preference alignment.
summary.zh: 将少步图像生成器的训练拆分为代理奖励学习与生成器优化，使不可微奖励也能用于后训练。方法沿 TDM 的确定性生成轨迹构造逐步奖励信号，并在文字渲染、视觉质量和偏好对齐等任务中评估效果。

cover.alt: Animated conceptual overview of TDM-R1: Black-box reward; Reward surrogate; Generator learning.
